Study exercise derived from this source. Explain the approach in your own words, work through an example, and identify edge cases. For code, implement your own version and discuss its time and space complexity.

Original source context
// https://www.lintcode.com/problem/powx-n/description?_from=ladder&&fromId=1

class Solution {
    private:
    double pow(double x,long long n){
        if(n == 0)
            return 1.0;
        double half = pow(x, n/2);
        if(n % 2)
            return half * half * x;
        else
            return half * half;
        
    }
public:
    /**
     * @param x: the base number
     * @param n: the power number
     * @return: the result
     */
    double myPow(double x, int n) {
       return n < 0 ? 1.0/pow(x,n) : pow(x,n);
    }
};
